text:
Leah W: heads-up — starting aurora-11b onboarding. found odd kv behavior with rotary embeddings after q4_0 quant.
Omar K: what kind of odd? latency, correctness, or crashes?
Leah W: correctness. short prompts fine, but after ~2500 tokens generator starts repeating and attention seems to focus on wrong context spans. looks like kv lookup/offset mismatch.
Zheng Li: can you paste the smoke command you ran?
Leah W: here: 
```bash
python tools/kv_smoke.py --model aurora-11b --quant q4_0 --max-len 4096 --prompt-file tests/long_story.txt --seed 42
```
Leah W: output snippet: 
```
[2026-11-02 14:12:03] INFO running step 1150 len=3200
[2026-11-02 14:12:03] WARN kv_cache: expected idx 3199 got 3201, dropping frame
[2026-11-02 14:12:03] DEBUG attn_scores[0][..] peak shifted by 17 tokens
```
Evan R: hmm that index off-by-two looks like a RoPE/rotary implementation mismatch when we reduce precision. we saw similar with another model when kernel fused the rotary multiply in a different order.
Omar K: do we have a repro w/ float32 runtime?
Leah W: yes, float32 runtime passes. int8-ish quant (q4_0, q4_k_mixed) fail. q8_0 seems better but still occasional drift.
Zheng Li: assign preliminary priority? this can be silent correctness regression for any long-context user. I vote P1 for onboarding until we rule out model vs runtime.
Leah W: agreed P1. annotated test failures in the onboarding ticket: https://redwood.example/tickets/RI-2217 (private)
build-bot: new-artifact aurora-11b.q4_0 uploaded to staging (sha: d9f3a1)
Omar K: next steps I suggest: 1) run the same harness with kernel debug logs enabled: 
```py
# set env to verbose kernel logging
export RW_KERNEL_DEBUG=rotary,memory
python tools/kv_smoke.py --model aurora-11b --quant q4_0 --max-len 4096
```
2) run same test with alternative rotary implementation (rotary_v2) to see if ordering fixes it.
Leah W: starting the two runs now, will attach logs. estimated 30m.
Zheng Li: also try disabling continuous batching (set BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=1) — to rule out batching-induced key indexing issues.
Evan R: good call. if that changes behavior, it's likely a batching+quant kernel race.
Leah W: quick interim result: with RW_KERNEL_DEBUG=rotary we see extra casts in fused kernel on q4_0 path. attaching small excerpt: 
```
rotary_mul: input dtype=q4_0 -> cast to fp16 -> multiply -> cast back -> store
kv_store: write_idx computed as seq_len + offset, offset=0 normally but sometimes offset=2
```
Omar K: that cast-back step could introduce rounding that changes alignment in the int path. can you repro with q4_k_mixed?
Leah W: q4_k_mixed shows same warnings but different pattern. q8_0 mostly clean.
Zheng Li: plan: 1) reproduce deterministically with seed/fixture, 2) test rotary_v2, 3) test no-batching, 4) if still failing open runtime bug referencing these logs and tag runtime eng.
Leah W: created runtime bug: https://redwood.example/bugs/RRT-909 (private) and tagged @eng-runtime.
Evan R: also add evals: run the long-context rouge/perplexity suite to quantify quality delta. add hallucination checklist too (QA prompts).
Leah W: will run evals after repro confirmed. putting a hold on promoting q4_0 build for aurora-11b.
Omar K: thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
